song_craft: Cremation-ground song (10v): broken-middle-drunk → lotus-skulls → seed-mirrored → letters-turn → gore-teaches → brow-burns → tied-aimed → sky-speaks → dark-shows → parted-freed. Rauhine register throughout.

lines: In the Power-egg's broken middle — world-saps — all I drink, always;
skull-cup-blood-pretext shown — this, as it were, my inside.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śāktāṇḍakhaṇḍamadhye viśvarasāḥ sarvam ahaṃ pibāmi sadā vyañjayasi narakapālagarudhiramiṣād etad iva me 'ntaḥ

lines: Pride-heart-bond uprooters — those two, these crested embodied —
lotus-skulls as it were — showing, held by You, great Time.
l4.sanskrit_cite: abhimānahṛdayabandhānutkhātau tāv imau saśikhau mūrtāv iva muṇdābjau prathayan dhatse mahākālaḥ

lines: All-world's seed-ground, first station — mirrored, waking-treasure;
palm-pomegranate show-play, O god.
l4.sanskrit_cite: akhilajagadbījabhuvaṃ prathamasthām anukaroṣi bodhanidhe karatalagabījapūrakadarśanalīlāyitād deva
